sloka: यज्ञ उपसदनम् ब्रह्मन् प्राप्तो असि मुनिभिः सह ।द्वादश अहम् तु ब्रह्मर्षे दीक्षाम् आहुः मनीषिणः ॥१-५०-१५॥
transliteration: yajña upasadanam brahman prāpto asi munibhiḥ saha ।dvādaśa aham tu brahmarṣe dīkṣām āhuḥ manīṣiṇaḥ ॥1-50-15॥

translations.english: O Brahmarshi learned men say, only twelve days remain for completion of this acrifice. Thereafter O Viswamitra you should see devatas claiming their shares".
